stage.stage01.name: Slime Hunting Grounds
stage.stage02.name: Magic Shop
intro.stage02.line: Shop build. Doubt the ledger too.
stage.stage03.name: Jump Dungeon
intro.stage03.line: Dungeon build. Doubt even how it feels to play.
stage.stage04.name: Room of Cards
intro.line: Build #1. One defect is on record. Find it and report it.
intro.hint: Some defects only surface when you play. Touch everything.
challenge.tutorial: Press when you are sure. You only get one report.
challenge.pickObject: Point at the object that's defective
category.title: What's wrong with it?
category.no-action.desc: Pressing or using it does nothing
category.weird-movement.desc: It moves in a strange way, direction, or speed
category.graphic.desc: Something looks wrong — shadow, color, shape
category.physics.desc: It passes through things or floats in the air
category.logic.desc: Numbers or rules don't add up
result.success.title: Defect confirmed
result.success.body: Accurate report. This build is signed off.
result.fail.title: False positive
result.fail.body: Report rejected. Rebuilding — a different defect will hide this time.
bug.E1.desc: Cards: one card wouldn't flip no matter how you clicked it.
bug.E2.desc: Cards: one card flipped vertically while every other card flipped sideways.
bug.E4.desc: Tries counter: it only went up once every two tries.
bug.E5.desc: Shuffle button: it played the shuffle motion but the cards never moved.
bug.E6.desc: Flower pot: it hovered in mid-air past the table's edge.
bug.E7.desc: Picture frame: the picture inside was hung upside down.
bug.E8.desc: Cards: one pair with clearly identical pictures refused to match.
stage.stage05.name: Forage
intro.stage05.line: Foraging build. Check what picks up, what hurts, what grows back.
stage.stage06.name: Shooting Gallery
intro.stage06.line: Gallery build. Tap the passing targets to knock them down. One target is off.
bugdesc.noAction: {obj}: pressing it did nothing at all.
bugdesc.noCollision: {obj}: the character could walk straight through it.
bugdesc.floating: {obj}: it hovered in mid-air and never fell.
bugdesc.freezeAnimation: {obj}: its animation was frozen, while the others of its kind kept moving.
bugdesc.mirrorShadow: {obj}: its shadow fell on the wrong side of the light.
bugdesc.counterSkew: {counter}: it moved by a different amount than it displayed. ({obj})
stage.engine01.name: [Engine] Slime Hunting Grounds
bugdesc.speedScale: {obj}: it ran at half the normal speed.
bugdesc.teleportOnEnd: {obj}: on reaching its end it teleported back instead of turning around.
bugdesc.bounceOnEnd: {obj}: it recoiled backwards every time it hit the end.
bugdesc.offsetGlow: {obj}: its light glowed in the wrong spot, away from the object.
bugdesc.wiringSwap: {obj}: its wiring was swapped, so it operated the wrong target.
bugdesc.noBounce: {obj}: stepping on it did not bounce you.
result.dead.title: Build crashed
result.dead.body: Health ran out and the session ended. The defect went unreported.
bugdesc.invertMeter: {obj}: it moved the opposite way from the real value.
bugdesc.noHit: {obj}: tapping it never registered a hit, while the others did.
wb.patchBaseline: · First build. What you see now is the baseline.
wb.specEmpty: Nothing recorded yet. Tap an object in the world to observe it.
rp.title: Repro
rp.ticketBody: Buying from the shop sometimes gives two items. Not every time, just now and then.
rp.instruct: Select every condition the repro needs, and only those. Miss one and the repro is unstable; add one it does not need and the developer digs in the wrong place.
rp.logEmpty: Tap an item to buy it. Attempts show up here.
rp.okBody: The conditions are exact. The developer reproduced it on the first try.
rp.unstableBody: A condition is missing. The developer followed your steps and nothing happened.
rp.noisyBody: Something in there is not needed. The developer dug in the wrong place.
cond.repeatSame: the same item is tapped {n} times in a row
cond.withinSeconds: tapped within {s}s of the previous action
office.name: QA floor
office.alreadyDone: This machine is done for today.
office.dev.intro: “Four builds up. There will be one in each.”
office.dev.caught: "Reproduced it on the first try. The fix lands in the next build."
office.dev.missed: "You let that one through, right? ...I will note it down anyway."
office.dev.allDone: "That is today's lot. You can clock out."
office.dev.idle0: "There is coffee. Over by the bookcase."
office.dev.idle1: "Nothing scares me like something that used to work."
office.dev.idle2: "I do not trust my own code either. That is what you are for."
office.dev.idle3: "If the build numbers blur, call them by the machine. A, B, C, D."
office.dev.idle4: "Did I ask about moving the date? I did. They said no."
office.dev.handoff: "{n} filed. They go into the next build." (+{pay} won)
office.dev.waiting: "Bring them all at once if you like. Just get here before you knock off."
home.name: My room
home.rested: An hour on the sofa. You have made back what last night's overtime took.
home.alreadyRested: You have rested enough for tonight.
home.notYet: The office is locked at this hour. Sleep first.
street.name: The walk in
street.gotCoffee: Coffee drunk. One more build in you. (+{n} min on the clock)
goal.stage01: Attack the jelly monsters for points
goal.stage02: Tap a shelf item to buy it. Ten gold each.
goal.stage03: Collect the coins. Avoid the spikes and bats.
goal.stage05: Gather the green herbs. Red toadstools and wasps hurt on contact
goal.stage06: Tap the targets. Lower rails are faster and worth more.
hint.sideView: Left and right to move · ⤒ to jump
item.magnifier.desc: Hold the magnifier button in a build to zoom to twice size
item.chair.desc: After overtime or a weekend shift, you lose fewer builds tomorrow
bugdesc.noPickup: {obj}: walking over it picked up nothing, while the others of its kind worked.
bugdesc.noRespawn: {obj}: once taken it never grew back, while the others of its kind did.
bugdesc.noDamage: {obj}: touching it did no harm at all, while the others of its kind hurt.
hint.keysAttack: Arrow keys to move · button to attack
home.morningFirst:
Two weeks to ship.
I am the last person to look at a build before it goes out.
What I miss goes out with it.
home.morning: Day {n}. Today’s builds are waiting. Time to get in.
home.tooEarly: It is still morning. Lie down now and today’s builds go out as they are.
street.shut: The day is done. Go home.
common.alreadyFine: You are fine as you are. Save it.
goal.stage04: Turn the cards over and match the pairs
offer.overtime.title: Six o'clock
offer.overtime.body: Six o'clock, and a build you have not looked at. You can work half an hour more, but tomorrow you will be able to look at fewer.
offer.coffee.title: Vending machine
offer.coffee.body: A coffee lets you look at one more build today. The clock moves forward fifteen minutes.
offer.adFailed: Ad unavailable. Try again in a moment.
street.freeCoffee: A coffee for the price of an ad. The time is still yours.
home.hobbyDid: Half a day off and you feel human. Your next working day starts half an hour early. ({n} won)
home.hobbyDone: That is enough for one day.
home.hobbyBroke: You do not have {n}. Earn it this week.
home.wentInAnyway: A weekend shift. One machine has a hotfix on it. Hand it over and the worst defect that already shipped is undone.
home.morningWeekend: It is the weekend. Nobody is waiting today.
street.weekend: Locked for the weekend. Decide at home if you are going in.
home.nothingToFix: Nothing has gone out yet. No reason to go in.
office.tooTired: You cannot look at another one. Coffee, or clock out.
result.fail.bodyFinal: Report rejected. This build ships as it is.
home.nothingOwed: No overtime today. You can go straight to bed.
office.whatCondition: {n} builds left in you today. Each one you sign off spends one. Sleep brings you back to three; the fourth only comes from a coffee.
office.whatChip: {machine}, severity {sev}. If it ships without being checked, the star rating drops — the more pips, the further.
offer.overtime.free: Watch an ad — half an hour free
office.stayedLate: {n} minutes more. You will be able to look at fewer builds tomorrow.
stage.stage07.name: The drinks machine
intro.stage07.line: Drinks machine build. Press what you want to drink. One thing is wrong.
goal.stage07: Press a button. That drink is the one that drops.
codex.title: The defect book
office.dev.coffee: The developer slides a coffee across without a word. “Get that in you.”
office.dev.collected: The developer catches you at the door. “Leave that one with me.” ({pay} won)
office.dev.warm1_0: “Oh, it’s you. Anything for me today?”
office.dev.warm2_0: “Honestly, before you got here this stuff just shipped.”
office.dev.warm2_1: “What you wrote down reproduced exactly. That is rare.”
office.dev.warm3_0: “When this ships I owe you a meal.”
office.dev.warm3_1: “If anything is left, say so. I will come and get it.”
office.dev.step1: “Coffee? I’ll make it.” — once a day, on them.
office.dev.step2: “I’ll come and get one.” — once a day the developer walks over and takes it, so you do not.
office.dev.step3: “Leave anything with me.” — at clocking-off time the developer takes the worst thing you did not hand over.
office.dev.cameOver: The developer walks over to your desk. “I’ll take that one.” ({pay} won)
home.morningFreeze: Day {n}. Code freeze. From today every build on the machines is critical, and everything pays half.
item.shoes.desc: You cross the office, the street and the flat faster
item.thermos.desc: Coffee puts five minutes on the clock instead of fifteen
item.retest.desc: Once in the twelve days, a build you reported wrongly can be checked again
office.retested: Re-test filed. The build is back, with a different fault.
settings.title: Settings
shop.removeAds.body: The free half hour and the free coffee stay exactly as they are — one of each a day. You just stop sitting through thirty seconds to take them.
shop.removeAds.owned: Bought. The free offers come without the wait.
settings.wipeSure: Erase it · this cannot be undone
street.pochaAte: A hot bowl and a drink. Your spirits are up. ({n} won)
street.pochaShut: It is still daylight. The tent is not even up.
street.pochaFine: Tonight you would rather just get home.
street.pochaBroke: You do not have {n}. Another night.
spirit.name: Spirits
spirit.endHigh: Two weeks of it, and you are still standing.
spirit.endMid: It shipped. What next week is for, you could not say.
spirit.endLow: It shipped. There is not much of you left.
quest.goWork: Get to work — the front door
quest.outOfEyes: Out of eyes — coffee, or home
quest.coffee: Buy a coffee — for build four
home.morningBright: Day {n}. You slept well. Today looks doable.
home.morningFlat: Day {n}. Your eyes are open. The rest of you is not.
office.dev.worried: “You have looked rough lately. Go home early today.”
spirit.what:
Your spirits. The stall on the way home raises them; overtime and weekend shifts lower them.
The day after working late you can look at fewer than three builds — and the more spirits you have left, the fewer you lose.
lane.name: Your block
street.a.m0: …sorry. I think I nodded off standing up.
street.a.m1: Everyone on this street at this hour has the same face.
street.a.m2: It is not the getting in that is hard. It is the rest of it.
street.a.e0: Off already? I have another two hours in me, apparently.
street.a.e1: I walk home on days like this. The train just ends the day for you.
street.b.m1: Got to bed at three. Expect I will again tonight.
street.b.m2: The machine coffee is better than it looks. Costs you a few minutes.
street.b.e0: Going home? No. Smoke, then back up.
street.b.e1: Two kinds of people leave at this hour. Finished, or given up.
street.c.m0: Off to work? I am off today, as it happens.
street.c.m1: That building ships something this week. Lights on every night.
street.c.m2: We keep meeting in the mornings. Same timetable, I suppose.
street.c.e0: Late again. There is a stall up at the end of the block tonight.
street.c.e1: I counted the lit windows. That building's stay on longest.
street.a.freeze: Code freeze, I hear. Nothing left to fix it with, and they still want it looked at.
street.a.tired: …you have my face on this morning. Late one, was it.
street.b.freeze: Nobody touches the code this week. So what are we for, exactly.
street.b.tired: You are going to read a build with those eyes? Have another before you go up.
street.c.freeze: The lights in that building are on till dawn now. Deadline, I suppose.
street.c.tired: You came in late last night. I hear the stairs.
pocha.last: "Tomorrow is the day, they tell me. Have another bowl on me, then."
pocha.freeze: "Everyone from that building comes at this hour lately. Something must be on."
pocha.low0: "Look at the state of you. More broth, and eat it slowly."
pocha.low1: "I will not ask you anything tonight. Just finish it."
pocha.mid1: "The people who come at this hour all have the same face."
pocha.high0: "You look all right tonight. Good day, was it."
pocha.high1: "Nice to have somebody turn up smiling for once."
office.dev.lastFlat: "Tomorrow is the ship. Whatever we miss today goes out as it is."
office.dev.lastKnown: "Last one tomorrow. Let's just get through today's."
office.dev.lastWarm: "You have had a fortnight of it. Today's, and then tomorrow we watch it go out together."
office.dev.weekend: "Did not expect to see you on a Saturday. Do not stay long."
office.dev.freeze: "Nothing gets fixed now. We should still know what is going out."
office.dev.shipGood: "It is out. First time I have not been nervous about one."
office.dev.shipOk: "It is out. A few went with it, but they always do."
office.dev.shipBad: "It is out, technically. I will be on the phone all next week."
office.dev.shipWarm: "Everything you handed me went out fixed. And I still owe you dinner."
event.hotfix.morning: Day 5. A message at three in the morning: something in the last release is on fire. So much for the night.
office.dev.hotfix: "The last release blew up. There is a hotfix on machine A — start with that one."
offer.dinner.title: Team dinner
offer.dinner.body:
"Everyone is going for a drink. Coming? The company is paying."

It lifts your spirits. Getting in late shortens tomorrow morning.
event.dinner.went: An evening of listening to other people's problems for once. Your spirits are up, and tomorrow will start short.
event.dinner.skipped: You said your goodbyes at the door. The street is quiet.
mutter.a1: Should have bought the coffee first.
mutter.a2: Let it be an early one today.
mutter.c0: Came out for the shopping and just stood here.
mutter.c1: Late again in that flat, by the look of it.
mutter.c2: Wind has gone cool, at least.
mutter.dev2: If this goes out as it is, we are finished.
mutter.dev3: What do I even write in the commit.
loading.title: Getting ready
loading.sub: Fetching the builds and the art
